name: Size / Diameter (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter has a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For the singleton class $\mathcal S_n$, $|\mathcal S_n|=n$ while $\mathrm D(\mathcal S_n)=2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, $\mathrm D(\mathcal T_n)=n$ while $|\mathcal T_n|=2$.
proof: The Singleton and Trivial-Concept value calculations give the two opposite unbounded gaps.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Size and Diameter of Singletons and Trivial Concepts.
